llm_miss_path_latency.source: Real measured wall-clock round-trip times to OpenRouter API (nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free) during Phase 4 labeling, recorded in data/openrouter_synthetic_feedback_telemetry.json. Not re-measured here -- API quota preserved.

token_usage.source: Real measured prompt/completion token counts from 22 genuine OpenRouter API calls recorded in data/openrouter_synthetic_feedback_telemetry.json. 86 fallback records (API errors) are excluded -- they have no real token counts.

cost_projection.label: Cost avoided under gpt-4o-mini's published pricing as of 2026-09-19 (https://openai.com/api/pricing/), applied to real token counts from this repo's API telemetry (22 genuine judge calls in data/openrouter_synthetic_feedback_telemetry.json). NOT an unqualified savings figure: the actual model (nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free) was used on the free tier (zero dollars billed).

production_projection.label: PROJECTION (not a measured result): at 10,000 queries/day and Phase 3 ARR=10% (source: docs/phase3_final_decision.md), applying the gpt-4o-mini pricing assumption stated above. Every cache HIT avoids one judge call.

cache_hit_path_latency.measurement_method: Wall-clock time.perf_counter() over 50 runs after 5 warm-up runs (discarded). Includes: QueryEmbedder.encode() + FlatVectorStore.search() (top-1 FAISS). Excludes: model load time (model already warm).

latency_delta.summary: A cache hit takes ~29.0ms (mean) vs ~4239ms for a fresh LLM judge call -- a 99% or 4210ms reduction (mean). Median: 28.3ms vs 2466ms (99% reduction). LLM latency derived from real measured telemetry. Cache hit latency measured locally on this machine.
